whenToUse: Mobile apps with a drawer menu, such as email or messaging.
It's offered as a shortcut alongside a menu button.
There are no sideways gestures in the middle of the screen.
whenNotToUse: Where it overlaps the operating system's back gesture (the left edge on iOS).
There's only the gesture and no menu button.

alternatives.name: Drawer
alternatives.reason: A drawer opened with a menu button.

alternatives.name: Swipe Navigation
alternatives.reason: Flicking through screens of the same kind.

accessibility: The menu button announces whether it's open with aria-expanded.
The open menu closes with Esc or a tap outside.
When closed, the menu is hidden, so Tab doesn't enter it.
The current mailbox is marked with aria-current.
